title: rotcast
blurb: an unhinged podcast transcript generator with a swappable lineup (any two accounts can cohost) and a surprise guest kidnapped off the live firehose or the hosts colikes. the banter itself now blends madlib templates and a markov chain built from the cohosts' own posts mixed with the rot, at @antiali.as's request. antiali.as and @fromthewestmeadow.com stayed the default lineup and the reset button.
